I could transmit the coordinates to Commander Antilles in Boordist or Vaathkree trade language for example&mdash;''"<br />"''And then you'd send them the translation?''"<br />"''Of course&hellip; Oh dear&hellip;|Han Solo, Princess Leia and C-3PO talk at the battle of Filve|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Vaathkree trade language''' was an obscure, possibly extinct language that was one of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] six million forms of communication. He suggested its use as a form of code to use to talk to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] at the [[Battle of Filve]], before [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] pointed out that Wedge could not speak Vaathkree [[Trade language/Legends|trade language]].

Upon nearing [[Demonsgate]], the ''[[FarStar]]'' picked up a distress signal in the Vaathkree trade language.<ref name="TKR">''[[The Kathol Rift]]''</ref>
